queer_characters.name: Ned Weeks
queer_characters.notes: Described as an openly gay writer and activist who drives the story's AIDS awareness efforts and founds GMHC.

queer_characters.name: Felix Turner
queer_characters.notes: Described as a closeted gay journalist in a romantic relationship with Ned; storyline involves him developing AIDS, tying his arc to illness during the crisis.

queer_characters.name: Bruce Niles
queer_characters.notes: Described as a charismatic gay man serving as GMHC president.

queer_characters.name: Mickey Marcus
queer_characters.notes: Described as a gay friend within the activist circle.

queer_characters.name: Tommy Boatwright
queer_characters.notes: Described as a gay activist involved in the grassroots organizing.

queer_creators.name: Larry Kramer
queer_creators.notes: Wrote the original 1985 play and this film's screenplay; based the protagonist Ned Weeks on his own life as a gay activist and writer.
